My Salutations to all Pious Souls...

Today was the 'seventh day' of the 'life consecration' ceremony of the Shree Mangal Murti which is going to take place during the auspicious festival of Navratri.

Today prayers were offered to the Guru-energies for all the artists and artisans who made the Shree Mangal Murti, and the artisans, labourers, engineers, contractors who constructed the Shree Gurushaktidham, and all those who provided support for this grand construction - that they should continue constructing such pure buildings in their life, and also for their 'overall progress'.

Today's Anushthan took place from 8.30am to 4.30pm. The world inside is like that of a 'cave', and one does not come to know about the time there at all.

Lots of Blessings to all of you.

Your own
Baba Swami
